#TBNWFMinManila
#TheBoyNextWorld
#BossNoeul #BoNoh 

GUIDE FOR INTERFANS OR OUT-OF-TOWNERS:

The venue is Music Museum https://t.co/j0OQEKwdPW

It is located in the Greenhills Shopping Complex, a safe area surrounded by shopping centers and bordering upscale gated communities. If you want to stay nearby, check accommodations within the complex and you will be just walking distance to the venue.

If you’re more comfortable staying in familiar hotel chains like Holiday Inn or Crowne Plaza, you can check the hotels in an area called Ortigas as it is the nearest to Greenhills. It is not walking distance and requires a short Grab ride.

Download Grab app if you still don’t have it. If you have one for Thailand, the same app will work in Manila.

Manila is TRAFFIC. You can stay in more popular areas like BGC or Makati, but take note of the time it will take for you to travel all the way to Greenhills.

Our airports are…complicated. Please take note of the terminal (1 or 3) where you land for easier pick-up and drop off.

While a lot of shops here already accept cashless payments, it is still recommended that you bring a bit of cash. You can use international cards in some major ATMs or go to a reputable money exchange shop.

Last, please register to https://t.co/iVBU9NhyPx three days before your planned travel. You will not pass through immigration without it. Please also check your respective embassies if you require a visa for travel here.

See you in Manila! 🇵🇭
